titulo: How a space telescope sees: inside the James Webb
caption: How do you see galaxies whose light left over 13 billion years ago? Webb uses a 6.5-meter mirror made of 18 gold-coated hexagons to collect infrared light. A five-layer sunshield blocks the Sun's heat, so the detectors stay below -223°C (-369°F). Which machine should we explain next? Let us know in the comments and follow for more.
